description: Property edits on a writable copy of the property fixture, with the Property object held throughout. PText.Value is read and set in turn to its same value, a same-length value, a longer value, a shorter value and Null (each read back), and PText.Type is set; PMemo is shrunk; then PText is deleted (held object's Name/Value read, Count before and after Refresh), deletion of the built-in Version property is attempted, and inside Workspaces(0).BeginTrans/Rollback PLong.Value is changed and PInTransaction appended. After Rollback PLong and PInTransaction are read; after Close and reopen all Database properties are enumerated.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
